# Speech clips for the model test

Two short clips, resampled to 16 kHz mono PCM16, for `model_tests.rs` (`#[ignore]`: it needs the model).

- `en-librispeech-1272-128104-0000.wav`: LibriSpeech dev-clean 1272-128104-0000 (Vassil Panayotov,
  Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey, Sanjeev Khudanpur; read from LibriVox), CC BY 4.0, https://www.openslr.org/12.
  "Mister Quilter is the apostle of the middle classes and we are glad to welcome his gospel."
- `fr-fleurs-1570.wav`: FLEURS fr_fr validation, id 1570 (Google), CC BY 4.0,
  https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs. "Il n'avait pas non plus le pouvoir de déroger aux lois
  fiscales ni à celles sur les droits de douane entre les États."
